approvalInstructions.approve: Serve the exact copy after the whole packet and coverage report pass.
approvalInstructions.revise: Replace copy with replacementCopy, then return the revised row for owner approval.
approvalInstructions.omit: Keep this combination silent. Never substitute another row.
approvalInstructions.activation: No row in this packet is reader-eligible until its decision is APPROVE and the selection rule is separately approved.

sourceAuthority.proseStatus: draft for owner review; no runtime serving authority

selectionRule.fullMoonLightRule: Evaluate both lights. When the same body qualifies against both, retain only its higher-scoring contact.
selectionRule.nodeRule: Treat the North and South Nodes as one axis and never render two nodal blocks.
selectionRule.rulerRule: A ruler condition qualifies only for retrograde, a station within three days, or a last-degree ingress within three days. When the ruler wins the aspect selection, merge any qualifying ruler condition into that aspect block and never render a second paragraph. Otherwise render at most one separate ruler block.
selectionRule.ingressRule: Mention ingress only when the ingressing body rules the lunation sign, is at 29 degrees at the lunation, and changes signs within three days. A station outranks an ingress.
selectionRule.silenceRule: Missing, omitted, or unapproved copy causes the block to omit. Never substitute another body, house, or aspect row.

aspectStems.copy: {{planet}} is conjunct this {{lunationKind}}, concentrating its concerns instead of letting them stay in the background.
{{planet}} opposes this {{lunationKind}}, making the tension visible through competing demands.

{{planet}} trines this {{lunationKind}}, giving you a usable current of support if you act on it.
{{planet}} sextiles this {{lunationKind}}, opening an opportunity that still needs your participation.

A familiar form of avoidance competes with the quieter work of release. The next step may be private, but it should move you toward participation in your life rather than farther away from it. This Full Moon is in your 12th house of karma, subconscious, and endings. Give yourself enough privacy to hear what is surfacing, but do not confuse privacy with having to carry it alone.

houseBridges.domain: Self, a time to reclaim yourself, energy, and power
houseBridges.copy: Notice which response belongs to who you are now and which one belongs to an identity you have outgrown.
Let your next financial choice reflect what you value, not only what makes the uncertainty stop.

houseBridges.domain: early education, how to process information, and communicate with your community, siblings, and neighbors
houseBridges.copy: Say the clearest true thing you can say, then leave enough space to hear what comes back.
Take time to check in and feel, you cannot think your way out of emotion.
Make room for what feels alive without turning it into a performance you have to maintain.
Choose the routine your body can live with, not the one that looks most disciplined from the outside.
Let the relationship show you what is mutual, then make your decision from what is actually being exchanged.

houseBridges.domain: transformation, symbolism, and other people's money
houseBridges.copy: Don't fear what you might transform into.

houseBridges.domain: the higher self, philosophy, and greater wisdom
houseBridges.copy: Let the question become larger than the answer you arrived with.
Choose the work you are willing to be known for, including the way you do it.
Notice which connections make more of you possible and which require you to disappear to belong.
Give yourself enough privacy to hear what is surfacing, but do not confuse privacy with having to carry it alone.

rulerConditionStems.copy: {{ruler}} is retrograde, so the part of this cycle it governs develops through review, return, and correction before forward movement becomes clear.
{{ruler}} stations within three days of this {{lunationKind}}, turning the issue into a real pivot rather than background pressure.
{{ruler}} is in the last degree of {{rulerSign}} and changes signs within three days, so the current way of handling this is reaching its limit.
